meta.name: skill-creator
meta.description: Guide for creating effective skills. This skill should be used when users want to create a new skill (or update an existing skill) that extends Codex's capabilities with specialized knowledge, workflows, or tool integrations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创建或更新扩展能力的技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想为Codex添加自定义知识或工作流
copy.tagline_en: Create or update skills to extend capabilities
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to add custom knowledge or workflows to Codex

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会获得创建或更新技能的能力。技能是包含 SKILL.md 和可选资源的文件夹，能让 Claude 在特定领域（如 PDF 处理、数据库查询）执行专业工作流。
howto.when: 当用户要求 Claude 创建一个新技能或更新现有技能时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个 PDF 编辑技能，包含旋转 PDF 的脚本。
say.note: Claude 会引导你完成技能创建流程。

say.text: 更新我的 BigQuery 技能，添加新的表结构。
say.note: Claude 会修改现有技能文件。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude gains the ability to create or update skills. Skills are folders with a SKILL.md and optional resources that enable Claude to perform specialized workflows in domains like PDF processing or database queries.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks Claude to create a new skill or update an existing one.

say_en.text: Create a PDF editing skill with a script to rotate PDFs.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through the skill creation process.

say_en.text: Update my BigQuery skill with new table schemas.
say_en.note: Claude will modify the existing skill files.
